nodes.title: Restricted isometry property

nodes.summary: Let $r \ge 1$ and let $\mathcal{A}$ be a restricted isometry of order $5r$ with a constant $\delta < 1/10$, that is, $\delta_{5r}(\mathcal{A}) < 1/10$. Let $X_0$ have rank at most $r$. Then $X_0$ is the unique minimizer of the nuclear norm over the affine space $\{X : \mathcal{A}(X) = \mathcal{A}(X_0)\}$: every other $X$ with $\mathcal{A}(X) = \mathcal{A}(X_0)$ has $\lVert X_0\rVert_* < \lVert X\rVert_*$.
nodes.title: Exact recovery by nuclear norm minimization under restricted isometry
